source_note: 新增首次教学台词以日志为准。Wiki 的乱码装饰字形随机变化,保留实测的两个 X; 属性说明与 Wiki 一致,以句号结尾。

messages.context: Maxwell 新手流程实测台词（第 1 条）
messages.raw: §fCome back once you've put an accessory in your Accessory Bag!
messages.text: Come back once you've put an accessory in your Accessory Bag!
messages.zh: 先往饰品袋里放入一件饰品,然后再来找我!

messages.context: 首次介绍饰品; 两侧 X 是乱码样式装饰,不是台词
messages.text: Accessories are X magical X pieces of gear.
messages.gloss: 保留实测两个 obfuscated X 及样式边界,不把乱码装饰译成正文。
messages.zh: 饰品是一种 X 神奇 X 的装备。

messages.context: 让玩家收集并存放饰品
messages.raw: §fTo truly harness their power, collect as many as possible and store them in your §aAccessory Bag§f!
messages.text: To truly harness their power, collect as many as possible and store them in your Accessory Bag!
messages.zh: 要充分发挥它们的力量,就尽可能多地收集饰品,放进你的饰品袋!

segments.text: To truly harness their power, collect as many as possible and store them in your
segments.zh: 要充分发挥它们的力量,就尽可能多地收集饰品,放进你的

messages.context: 介绍饰品本身能力之外的作用
messages.raw: §fOn top of their existing abilities, each accessory makes your §aAccessory Bag §fmore powerful!
messages.text: On top of their existing abilities, each accessory makes your Accessory Bag more powerful!
messages.zh: 除了自带的能力,每件饰品还能让你的饰品袋变得更强!

segments.text: On top of their existing abilities, each accessory makes your
segments.zh: 除了自带的能力,每件饰品还能让你的

messages.context: 饰品之力由饰品稀有度决定
messages.raw: §fAccessories add some §6§lACCESSORY POWER §fto the bag depending on their §drarity§f.
messages.text: Accessories add some ACCESSORY POWER to the bag depending on their rarity.
messages.gloss: 用 order 将稀有度提前; 饰品之力仍保留金色粗体,句号恢复正文色。
messages.zh: 饰品会根据自身的稀有度,为饰品袋增加一定的饰品之力。

segments.text: to the bag depending on their

messages.context: 解释饰品之力增加属性; 日志与 Wiki 均以句号结尾
messages.raw: §fYes! The more §6Accessory Power§f, the more stats like §c❤ Health §for §b✎ Intelligence §fyou get from your §aAccessory Bag§f.
messages.text: Yes! The more Accessory Power, the more stats like ❤ Health or ✎ Intelligence you get from your Accessory Bag.
messages.gloss: Wiki 于 2026-09-03 更新,与实测台词一致。图标使用通用符号,引擎恢复实测字形。
messages.zh: 没错! 饰品之力越高,你的饰品袋提供的❤ 生命值、✎ 智力等属性就越多。

messages.context: 回应玩家称赞; amazing/magic 小玩笑
说明玩家可以选择属性
messages.raw: §fEven better, YOU choose what stats you get!
messages.text: Even better, YOU choose what stats you get!
messages.zh: 更棒的是,由你来决定获得哪些属性!

messages.context: 申请添加 Abiphone 联系人时
messages.raw: §b✆ §fThat way you'll be able to access my features from anywhere?
messages.text: ✆ That way you'll be able to access my features from anywhere?
messages.zh: ✆ 这样你在哪儿都能找我办事了?

messages.context: 假装索要能力石；下一句说明只是在开玩笑
messages.text: ✆ What about some more Luxurious Spool, hum?
messages.gloss: 此处保留物品搜索名；真正要交付的是下一句的糖果。
messages.zh: ✆ 要不再来点 Luxurious Spool，怎么样?

messages.context: 添加联系人需要交付两颗糖果
messages.text: ✆ I'm joking! Bring me Ultimate Carrot Candy x2.
messages.gloss: 2 是该任务固定的交付数量；商品名保留英文便于搜索。
messages.zh: ✆ 开玩笑的! 给我带 Ultimate Carrot Candy x2 就行。
